standard-dialogue.player: Who are you and what is this place?

standard-dialogue.npc: I collect valuable resources and pawn off access to them to foolish adventurers, like yourself.
You should take a look inside my arena. There's an abundance of valuable resources inside.

standard-dialogue.player: And I can take whatever I want?

standard-dialogue.npc: It's all yours. All I ask is you pay the upfront fee.

standard-dialogue.player: Will others be able to kill me inside?

standard-dialogue.npc: Yes. These walls will only hold them back for so long.
Haha! For the right price, I won't deny any one access to my arena. Even if their intention is to kill you.
My arena holds many treasures that I've acquired at great expense, adventurer. Their bounty can come at a price.
One day, adventurer, I will boast ownership of a much larger, much more dangerous arena than this. Take advantage of this offer while it lasts.

treasure-trails-master-talking-again.text: If the puzzle is not solved:

steps.npc: That doesn't look solved to me.
Well done [player name]. Here you go.
